name: code-reviews
description: Automated AI code review across GitHub, GitLab, and local agents. One review rubric and findings contract drive four surfaces: a GitLab CI job that reviews every merge request through swappable engines (docker-agent, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) with inline discussions and a sticky summary, a git pre-push hook, an in-session review command, and GitHub Copilot native review instructions. Delivery is deterministic script code, never an agent tool call, with a tokenless log-mode fallback.
